description: This is a FastAPI-based Python source file implementing a simple in-memory notes API with CRUD operations, health check, and CORS configuration.

classes.name: _NoteRecord
classes.description: Internal data class representing a note in the in-memory store.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Pydantic model for note data returned by the API.

classes.name: NoteCreate
classes.description: Pydantic model for creating a new note.

classes.name: NoteUpdate
classes.description: Pydantic model for updating an existing note (partial updates).

classes.name: _NotesStore
classes.description: In-memory store class managing notes with CRUD operations.

methods.name: _now_iso
methods.description: Returns current UTC time as an ISO-8601 string.

methods.name: _seed_if_empty
methods.description: Seeds initial notes if store is empty.

methods.name: _to_model
methods.description: Converts internal note record to API model.

methods.name: list_notes
methods.description: API endpoint to list all notes.

methods.name: create_note
methods.description: API endpoint to create a new note.

methods.name: get_note
methods.description: API endpoint to fetch a specific note by ID.

methods.name: update_note
methods.description: API endpoint to update a note by ID.

methods.name: delete_note
methods.description: API endpoint to delete a note by ID.
